670011101.text: Aino? Free today, are we? What brings you here to see me?

670011102.text: Just happened to pass by while out shopping with Ineffa, so we're dropping by to play!

670011103.text: I see. And here I thought you were going to pose me another head-scratcher. You know I don't quite get your designs...

670011104.text: Oh, and by the way, the equipment you helped me modify the other time was pretty useful. Thanks a bunch.

670011105.text: See? The processed ore is very pure, and the utilization rate is very high as well.

670011106.text: Of course! Who do you think's personally putting in the work tuning your stuff up, eh?

670011107.text: Yes, yes, Whiz-Kid Aino, it's you. Oh, yes. I just went to buy some snacks. Want some? Y'know, before Ineffa gets here.

670011108.text: Bribes, huh? Okay. What do you want help with this time? Just so we're clear, I don't do boring projects. And if it's strong hands you need, go find Ineffa.

670011109.text: Oh, come now. I just said I was thanking you for your help previously...

670011110.text: That's what you said last time, too — in fact, that's what you say every time. Pretty sure you're sure there's always gonna be a "next time," hmm?

670011111.text: Ahem, uh, let's not talk about that. Come on, here's the candy. There's chocolate and krumkakes too, if that's more your speed.
